title: When did your last period start?
subtitle: We use the first day of your last period to estimate your due date and suggest the right test windows for you.
errorMissing: Pick the date your last period started.
errorTooOld: That's more than {{weeks}} weeks ago — outside a typical pregnancy. Double-check the date.
